info.title: stride
info.description: Command-line tool for Stride: install Stride versions and create, build, and manage Stride projects.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: sdk
commands.description: Manage installed Stride versions (list, available, install, uninstall, update).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List installed Stride versions.

commands.name: available
commands.description: List Stride versions available from the package sources.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include prerelease (beta) versions when resolving the newest version or line. [default: False]

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install a Stride version (additive; never removes an existing one).

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include prerelease (beta) versions when resolving the newest version or line. [default: False]

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: Version or major.minor line to install. If omitted, installs the version the current directory's project needs, else the newest stable version.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Uninstall a Stride version.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update installed Stride lines to their newest patch.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include prerelease (beta) versions when resolving the newest version or line. [default: False]

arguments.name: LINE
arguments.description: Major.minor line to update (e.g. 4.4). Updates all installed lines if omitted.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a project from an installed Stride version's templates.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the generated project.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory (defaults to ./<name>).

options.name: --package
options.description: Additional template package to include (a package id, or a path to a local .nupkg). Repeatable.

options.name: --version
options.description: Use a specific Stride version instead of the newest installed one.

options.name: --force
options.description: Create the project even if the output directory already exists and is not empty (overwrites). [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: TEMPLATE
arguments.description: Template short name (e.g. stride-game). Run 'stride new list' to see them.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the templates available in an installed Stride version.

options.name: --version
options.description: Use a specific Stride version instead of the newest installed one.

options.name: --package
options.description: Additional template package to include (a package id, or a path to a local .nupkg). Repeatable.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade a project to a newer installed Stride version.

options.name: --version
options.description: Stride version to upgrade to (4.4.0 or newer). Defaults to the newest installed stable version.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Consider prerelease (beta) versions when choosing the newest version to upgrade to. [default: False]

options.name: --no-backup
options.description: Skip the automatic backup of files the upgrade modifies before editing in place. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Project or solution to upgrade. Defaults to the solution or project in the current directory.

commands.name: studio
commands.description: Open Game Studio.

options.name: --version
options.description: Open with a specific Stride version instead of the one from a project in the current directory.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Solution to open. Defaults to the solution in the current directory.

commands.name: asset
commands.description: Run the Stride Asset Compiler directly (advanced; arguments are forwarded).

options.name: --version
options.description: Use a specific Stride version instead of the one from a project in the current directory.

commands.name: crash
commands.description: List, show and send crash reports saved by Stride's headless tools.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List crash reports waiting to be sent.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Crash store base directory. Defaults to STRIDE_CRASH_DIR or the per-user location.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print a saved crash report's details, without sending it.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A run directory from 'crash list', or a single crash-*.json file.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a saved crash report, then delete it.

options.name: --dsn
options.description: Sentry DSN to send to. Defaults to the build's baked-in DSN, else the public Stride dev channel.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A run directory from 'crash list', or a single crash-*.json file.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Throw a test exception to exercise the crash-report pipeline.

commands.name: generate-legacy-shader-code
commands.description: Regenerate the C# from .sdsl/.sdfx shaders (Stride 4.0-4.3; 4.4+ generates it at build).

options.name: --version
options.description: Use a specific Stride version instead of the one resolved from the project.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Shader file (.sdsl/.sdfx), project, or solution to regenerate. Defaults to the solution or project in the current directory.

commands.name: legacy
commands.description: List commands kept for older (pre-4.4) Stride projects.

commands.name: self
commands.description: Manage the Stride CLI itself.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update the Stride CLI to its newest version.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Show the Stride CLI version and the resolved Stride version.
